input: univariate standardized causal history plus per-origin causal state features

linear_residual.history_projection_definition: last 96 normalized differences padded left when needed
linear_residual.mapping: single affine linear map from projected history and phi_t to residual path

dlinear.parameterization: last-value-anchored linear residual paths for seasonal and trend decompositions

m3_shuffle.permutation: fixed split-specific NumPy PCG64 permutation seeded by run seed plus 9001
m3_shuffle.meaning: breaks the pairing between each history and its state feature vector while retaining both marginal distributions
